$description: Numaya design tokens. Single source of truth. Format: W3C Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) draft, with CSS-compatible string values. Layers: primitive (raw values) → semantic (meaning) → component (explicit reusable needs). Build with `npm run tokens`; never edit generated files.

primitive.$description: Raw values. Never referenced directly by component CSS; use semantic or component tokens.

50.$description: Palest lavender: selected tints and soft brand buttons (purple text on it 4.7:1).

100.$description: Fresh lavender wash: guidance cards, brand screen washes, selected-row backgrounds (lighter and cooler than the sampled Meetup #F0ECF9).

150.$description: Stronger lavender tint: pressed tints, illustration framing, tracks under purple.

300.$description: Meetup hero purple (sampled #9C85E6): illustration details only (3.0:1 with white).

600.$description: Meetup primary purple (sampled #7262C7). White on it is 4.90:1.

700.$description: Hover and pressed purple (derived; white on it 6.4:1).

800.$description: Deep purple for text on lavender tints (derived; 7.4:1 on purple.100).

100.$description: Meetup promo card fill (sampled #D6DCFD, 'Start a new group').
Rose tint (derived) for avatar and category framing.

500.$description: Meetup accent rose (sampled #EA698C, organiser badge): badges and category marks, never text.

100.$description: Yellow tint (derived from #FCD284) for avatar framing.

200.$description: Meetup illustration yellow (sampled #FCD284, empty-state blob): illustration and avatar framing.

500.$description: Meetup time/status orange (sampled #D58B50, 'In 2m'): icons and marks only (2.75:1 on white).

100.$description: Meetup field, chip and incoming-bubble grey (sampled #F2F2F2).

200.$description: Meetup hairlines and the active tab pill (sampled #EEEDEE).

900.$description: Meetup ink (sampled #141316, switch on): text and ink fills.

600.$description: Danger text and badge fill (sampled Meetup red #DD544F, deepened to 5.6:1 with white and 5.0:1 on its tint).

700.$description: Success text (sampled Meetup green #5D946A deepened to 6.1:1 on white, 5.5:1 on its tint).

palette.$description: V9: the monochrome Numaya palette for the experiment (white and neutral greys; purple stays purple.600). Replaces the V6–V8 warm palette, which only the experiment used.

brand-tint.$description: V11: purple.600 at 10% on white (#7262C7 mixed into #FFFFFF).

secondary-strong.$description: Secondary moved toward Text: 4.85:1 on the inset grey and 5.16:1 on the secondary grey, where #77737D is 4.07 and 4.33.

muted.$description: 3.15:1 on white: disabled text and icons only, never body text.

withings.$description: V16: colours sampled from the Withings Health Mate iOS screens on Mobbin (artifacts/version-16-design-experiment/research/REFERENCE_ANALYSIS.md). Used only inside .theme-withings.

stone.$description: The warm off-white page (sampled #F6F3F3 / #F3F3F0 across 10 screens).

fill.$description: Segmented track and unselected fills (sampled #E4E4E4, warmed to sit on the stone page).

border.$description: Hairlines: row dividers inside cards, the tab bar's top edge, outlined information boxes (sampled #E3E2E0 / #E8E8E8 / #ECECEC).

border-strong.$description: Dashed empty photo slots and the sheet grabber (the reference's grabber samples #CCCCCC, warmed).

photo.$description: Photo placeholder grey, warm like the page (the reference's empty device and product tiles sample #DCD8D4 / #D8D4D0).

outline.$description: The 1px outline of text fields (sampled #6D6C6A), 5.25:1 on white.

control.$description: Unselected radio and checkbox rings (sampled #B0B0B0, deepened to 3.57:1 for the non-text contrast minimum).

ink.$description: Text, primary buttons, the selected radio, the active tab (sampled #0F0F0F / #0C0C0C).

secondary.$description: Secondary text: row subtitles, helper text (sampled #5F5D5E), 6.06:1 on stone.

muted.$description: Metadata and inactive labels (sampled #717171), 4.98:1 on stone and 4.51:1 on the fill.

disabled.$description: Disabled button fill (sampled #C3BDBA, lightened one step).

blue.$description: Withings blue (sampled #5166CC on the pace screen, #5064CC on 'Got it'): white on it 5.11:1.

blue-tint.$description: The light blue behind 'Explore data', 'All settings', the selected period tab and the privacy row (sampled #E4EBFC).

blue-deep.$description: Blue text on the tint (the 'Explore data' and 'Quarter' labels sample #3E4987 at their darkest), 6.8:1 on the tint.

green.$description: Switch track when on, completion checks (sampled #3C783C).

red.$description: Destructive buttons and notification dots (sampled #CF3336), white on it 5.02:1.

yellow.$description: Category mark tile (sampled #FCEAB7). Marks only, never text.

lavender.$description: Category mark tile (sampled #E4C9ED). Marks only, never text.

pink.$description: Category mark tile (sampled #FCCCC4). Marks only, never text.

fraunces.$value: "Fraunces Variable", ui-serif, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

hanken.$description: V16: the closest legally available match (SIL OFL) to the Withings app's grotesk: single-storey g, open apertures, a heavy bold.

semantic.$description: The public API for product UI. Names describe intent, not appearance.

default.$description: Meetup primary purple: selected pills and chips, outgoing bubbles, progress, links, send and confirm actions, switches' focus. White text and glyphs on it are 4.90:1 (AA).

hover.$description: Hover and pressed state of solid purple actions and controls.

tint.$description: Palest lavender surface for selected states and soft buttons; purple text 4.7:1.

tint-strong.$description: Stronger lavender: pressed tints and illustration framing.

soft.$description: Soft lavender secondary-button fill (Meetup 'Sign up with email').

hero.$description: Large decorative purple (hero washes, illustration framing). Never behind small text.

control.$description: One selected-state system for radios, checkboxes, switches, sliders, segmented pills and selected chips.

selected.$description: Checked radio, checkbox and switch track, slider interval, selected pill fill.

selected-text.$description: Text, ticks and thumbs on a selected control (4.90:1).

track-off.$description: Off switch track and empty slider rail (neutral).

on-brand.$description: Text and glyphs on a solid brand-purple fill: white, 4.90:1.

accent.$description: Meetup secondary palette, used by role only (badges, category and avatar framing, status marks), never as a second UI accent.

promo.$description: Periwinkle framing: avatar pastels and illustration accents (Meetup secondary palette). Never text.

rose.$description: Badges, category marks and the wordmark dot (Meetup accent rose).

muted.$description: Body copy, ledes, meta. 5.8:1 on white.

subtle.$description: Placeholders and disabled labels only (2.8:1, documented exception).

brand.$description: Links and brand-context text on white (Meetup 'See all', legal links). 4.90:1.

soft.$description: Meetup grey fills: fields, search, unselected filter pills, incoming bubbles, quote cards.

sunken.$description: Tracks, disabled fills, the active tab pill.

photo.$description: Neutral grey placeholder for a profile photo until licensed photography is supplied.

page.$description: App page background (Meetup: white pages; cards separate with a hairline and a faint shadow).

canvas.$description: Background behind app frames and showcase pages.

brand.$description: Lavender wash at the top of brand screens (Meetup Home header).

inverse.$description: Ink fills: primary CTAs, checked checkboxes, switches, toasts.

control.$description: Outlines of unchecked checkboxes and radios (3.4:1, meets non-text contrast).

ring.$description: Keyboard focus indicator: brand purple, 4.90:1 on white.

halo.$description: Soft lavender ring around a focused control.

field.$description: Focus stroke of fields, search, code cells and the composer: one 2px purple stroke plus the halo.

photo.$description: Bottom legibility overlay for text on photos (functional, not decorative).

badge.$description: Unread and notification count badges (Meetup red), white numerals 4.9:1.

palette.$description: V9: the monochrome palette by role, used only inside .theme-tiimo (artifacts/version-9-final-screenshot-preview/design-system.md). White and greys build the hierarchy; Brand is the one accent.

surface.$description: Primary content surfaces: outlined modules and groups, floating chrome (#FFFFFF).

surface-secondary.$description: Gentle separation without elevation: informational containers, the active tab item (#F7F7F8).

surface-inset.$description: Recessed controls: fields, search, composer, text areas, unselected pills and filters (#F0F0F2).

brand.$description: Primary actions, selection, the active tab icon (#7262C7).

brand-foreground.$description: Text and icons on solid brand purple (#FFFFFF, 4.90:1).

brand-tint.$description: V11: the one light purple (#F1EFF9). Holds a small brand-purple icon where it marks meaning (the prompt heading; purple on it 4.4:1). Never cards, pills, headings or large areas.

secondary-strong.$description: Secondary text on the grey surfaces (#6B6771).

muted.$description: Disabled foreground (#929099); not for readable text.

photo-fade.$description: The one gradient's colour: pure black, faded upward over the lower part of a real profile photograph that carries text (opacities set with color-mix in theme-tiimo.css). Never on surfaces, controls or decoration.

withings.$description: V16: the Withings Health Mate palette by role, used only inside .theme-withings (artifacts/version-16-design-experiment/design-system/TOKENS.md). A warm stone page, white cards that separate by surface contrast alone, near-black ink for text and primary actions, Withings blue for brand accents and selection tints, green for switches, red for destruction and notification dots.

surface.$description: Cards, grouped rows, fields, sheets, the tab bar and modal headers (#FFFFFF). No border or shadow on the stone page.

fill.$description: Segmented-control track, unselected filter and interest pills, recessed placeholders (#EAE9E6).

border.$description: Row dividers inside cards, modal header and tab bar edges, outlined boxes on the page (#E6E5E2).

border-strong.$description: Dashed empty photo slots, the sheet grabber (#D3D0CC). Decorative edges only.

photo.$description: Photo placeholders and missing activity images (#DFDDD9).

ink.$description: Primary text and headings, primary buttons, selected radios and option rings, the active tab (#121212).

text-muted.$description: Metadata, timestamps, inactive tab labels (#6B6966); 4.5:1 or better on every V16 surface.

accent.$description: Withings blue (#5066CC): your message bubbles, the SuperSwipe, checked checkboxes, slider fills, unread counts, links and focus.

accent-tint.$description: Selected filter and period pills, selected interests, the tinted action row (#E4EBFC).

accent-on-tint.$description: Text and icons on the blue tint (#3E4A8F, 6.8:1).

identity.$description: Initial avatars and portrait fallbacks (#203068) with white initials.

mark-yellow.$description: Round holder behind an emoji mark (category headings). Never text or controls.

mark-lavender.$description: Round holder behind an emoji mark. Never text or controls.

mark-pink.$description: Round holder behind an emoji mark. Never text or controls.

display.$description: Headlines, wordmark, prompt answers, sheet titles.

withings.$description: V16: the one family inside .theme-withings, for headings and text alike (the reference uses one grotesk throughout).

type.$description: Typographic roles. Each role has size, line, weight, tracking. Family: hero/display/headline/title use font.display; the rest use font.text.

gutter-tight.$description: Edge-to-edge content: the Discover card, chat header controls.

content-max.$description: Max content width on phones; wider viewports centre the column.

section-gap.$description: Gap between distinct content sections and grouped lists (Meetup rhythm), clearly larger than the 20px between form fields, so a group's footnote reads with its group.

field-gap.$description: Gap between form fields and between a field group and the next field.

stroke-bold.$description: Icons inside filled buttons and small sizes.

radius.$description: Soft rounded rectangles; tiers differ on purpose. Nested corners follow outer = inner + inset (tab bar xl 28 = item lg 20 + 8px padding). xs/sm: tags, chips, small inner elements. md: controls (buttons, fields, option cards). lg: cards, list groups, message bubbles, tab items. xl: hero profile card, sheets, dialogs, the floating tab bar. 2xl: framed screens. pill: only for genuinely pill-shaped things (progress bars, switches, slider tracks, count badges).

photo.$description: Large photography and hero images (Discover card, profile photos, match photos): the softest corner in the system.

card.$description: Major content containers: section cards, grouped rows, prompt cards, the floating options menu, reserved illustration areas. Between photo (32) and controls (md 16).

shadow.$description: Elevation scale. Neutral ink at low opacity. Flat controls and fields use none; they rely on surface contrast or a hairline border.

thumb.$description: White switch and slider thumbs: a barely-there edge and a soft drop so the white thumb reads on ink, purple, grey and white without an outline.

xs.$description: Tiny lift for small moving parts: switch knob, slider thumb, selected segment, selected option card.

sm.$description: Raised cards and list groups, floating icon buttons. Replaces outlines: no ring, just a soft contact shadow.

md.$description: Bottom sheets and bottom panels (shadow falls upward).

float.$description: Persistent chrome that floats over the page: the bottom tab bar and the hero profile card.

lg.$description: Dialogs, toasts and popovers: the only tier that must clearly read as layered.

button.$description: Primary ink buttons: a faint top highlight and a contact shadow.

brand.$description: Floating purple actions (Meetup 'Map' pill, confirm FAB): a contact shadow and a soft purple drop. Flat purple pills inside content use none.

tiimo-float.$description: Tiimo-inspired experiment (V9): the one elevation, a single soft diffuse layer for chrome that floats above content (tab bar, floating icon buttons, the FAB, Discover actions, sheets).

withings-float.$description: V16: the one elevation, for controls that float over a photograph (the SuperSwipe) and the toast. Cards on the page never take it.

withings-segment.$description: V16: lifts the selected segment off the segmented control's grey track (the reference's 'Programs / Library').

pending.$description: Content locked while a request is checking.

out.$description: Default for entering and state changes.

component.$description: Only for explicit reusable needs that semantic tokens cannot express.

primary.$description: Impeccable colorize: the primary action is flat brand purple (white 4.90:1), the same flat purple fill the system already uses for selection and SuperSwipe. Purple means 'move toward a conversation'.

ink.$description: Pass and Like on the action bar stay ink, so SuperSwipe remains the single purple choice in that row.

radius.$description: Six separate soft cells (chosen over one segmented group, whose empty positions disappeared): about a third of the 52px cell width, softer than fields' old 16px but not a capsule.

tiimo.$description: Tiimo-inspired experiment geometry. V10 balanced scale, chosen per component (artifacts/version-10-final-screenshot-preview/design-system.md): fully rounded pills for compact actions and toggles (filter tabs, segmented options, small buttons, Discover actions, counts, progress, switch tracks); generously rounded rectangles for structured controls and surfaces (tags 8, chips, fields, rows and icon buttons 12, buttons 14, cards, groups and tiles 16, photographs and sheets 20); conventional shapes where function needs them (circular radios, square checkboxes). Nested corners: inner ≈ outer − inset.

radius-check.$description: V10: checkboxes, a conventional slightly rounded square.

radius-tag.$description: V10: 24–27px labels and badges, the photo order badge and remove button (inset 8px in a 16px tile).

radius-chip.$description: V10: 36px content chips: interest and emoji pills, shared-interest and fact chips.

radius-control.$description: V10: 36–44px icon buttons, the send button, slider handles (half their height: a compact pill).

radius-item.$description: V10: fields, search, the composer, selection rows and opener rows.

radius-feature.$description: V10: cards, outlined groups, the prompt, information containers, photo tiles and slots, new-match portraits, message bubbles, the FAB, the readiness meter, your match photo.

radius-photo.$description: V10: full-width profile photographs, sheets and dialogs.

radius-pill.$description: V10: a fully rounded capsule (radius = half the height) for compact actions and toggles. Never on a square component, where it would make a circle.

handle-width.$description: V11: the switch handle, a horizontal pill (34 × 26) inset 3px in its 58 × 32 track.

handle-slider-width.$description: V11: the slider handle, the switch's horizontal pill one step smaller (30 × 22) for the 6px rail.

withings.$description: V16 geometry, measured from the Withings Health Mate screens (preview images 299px wide for a 393pt screen, so 1px ≈ 1.31pt; see TOKENS.md). Rounded rectangles throughout; full pills only for compact outlined actions and tint tabs; circles for header buttons, avatars, radios and switch thumbs.

radius-tag.$description: Outlined labels ('Withings+' badge), status labels, the checkbox.

radius-control.$description: Full-width buttons, tinted action rows, chips and interest pills (measured 10–12pt).

radius-card.$description: Cards, grouped rows, the prompt, information boxes, photo tiles, message bubbles (measured 12–14pt).

radius-pill.$description: Compact outlined actions ('Add a Reminder', 'Share'), period and filter tabs, segmented options, counts.

row-height.$description: Single-line rows in a grouped card (measured 56pt).

button-height-sm.$description: Small outlined pills ('Add a Reminder'), visible height inside the 44px target.

segment-inset.$description: Gap between the segmented track and its segments; a segment's corner is the track's minus this.

composer-radius.$description: Composer field corner: half its 44px height, a pill beside the round send button.

action-size.$description: Discover action circles and the step button.

mark-size.$description: Round pastel holder behind an interest-set emoji.

prompt-mark-size.$description: Round tint holder behind the prompt mark.

thumb-switch.$description: Switch thumb (iOS proportions in a 51 × 31 track).

type.$description: Final polish: the V16 type roles as tokens (they were raw values in theme-withings.css). Sizes from the reference (REFERENCE_ANALYSIS.md, Typography).

section-size.$description: Section and group headings, profile prompt answers

match-max.$description: Upper bound of the match title clamp (the lower bound is hero-size).
